text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. Another common use is translation, where tools like Google Translate change text from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which means finding out if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions in a helpful way. Thanks to NLP, computers can communicate with us more naturally every day.
